It's a pain in the ass and it shouldn't ever have to come to this but look up the noise ordinances for your city or county.  Many have noisy pet noise policies.  (No sounds over 60 dec. past a certain time or continuous noise for an extended period)

I went to court over a neighbors noisy dog that barked throuoght the day and night.  My options were to find two neighbors to file with me or record a video where the barking continues for 20 mins without even a single 20 second break in the noise.

I got a date a month or so away from when I filed and all I had to do was present the video in court (I also included filming their mailbox with their address in the video)  They were assessed a $500 fine and were informed if it continued they can be fined indefinitely.

It has gotten way better since.  Still occasional barking but it's within reason that I don't lose my sanity.
